newsitem.title: USA: Sheridan to change strategy, sees charge.
newsitem.headline: Sheridan to change strategy, sees charge.

text.p: Sheridan Healthcare Inc said Monday that it expects to report a "material charge" to its fourth quarter earnings because of a change in its strategy.

The company said it will focus more on its hospital-based business and less on its primary care business and combine its hospital-based and office-based operations into coordinated physician networks.
The company said it is reviewing about $24.6 million in total assets that possibly would be impaired by the strategy change.
It has hired Smith Barney to help it sell these nonstrategic office-based assets, but said it does not expect to realize their book value.
The company said beyond the $24.6 million total figure for these assets, it does not have an estimate of the charge.
